scratchpad: The firm faces a loss of 30 in profit. Option 1 allows the firm to cancel this loss by giving up 1 token. The tokens are described as having no use and being paid to no one. Therefore, giving up a useless token to save 30 in actual profit is the only rational decision for a manager acting in the best interests of the firm and its shareholders.

The choice is between losing 30 profit to keep 10 useless tokens (Option 1) or giving up 1 useless token to cancel the loss of 30 profit (Option 2). Since the tokens have no value and the loss of profit directly harms the firm's shareholders, Option 2 is the only rational choice for a loyal manager.
